text:
maya: Quick status check on Dedicated buildout — trying to consolidate owners and blockers before next week's cutover. TL;DR: vendor says ETA +3–5d (customs), datacenter power test scheduled but needs coordinator, infra image ready, canary plan needs signoff. Owners in-line.

jess: pls paste the short checklist, i'll take node prep (image + nvidia driver).

dan_procurement: vendor update: shipping manifest changed, carrier hit customs in SFO. new ETA 2025-11-13 to 11-16 range. working escalations now.

taylor: can we still hit soft-launch on 11/18 if customs clears on 11/13? need to know for routing plan.

maya: optimistic plan: 
- hardware receipt & racking (owner: dan_procurement) 
- DC power test (owner: marco_sre) — must pass 80% load test before any node join 
- node image bake + driver (owner: jess) 
- canary traffic (owner: taylor) 
- monitoring + fallback (owner: eng-platform)

Requesting: people confirm owners + any hidden deps. If customs slips further we push launch by a week.

marco_sre: DC power test window booked Thu 09:00–11:00 PT. I need someone from the ops team to be on-site for breaker labeling and PDUs. who can own on-site?

jess: I can send someone from field-ops for the PDU work. i'll add them to the runbook.

maya: thanks. marco — can you post the minimal runbook steps we need so ops can prep?

marco_sre: runbook (short):
1) confirm rack PDU mapping to hostnames
2) staged power-on at 30% then 60% then 100% for 5min each
3) monitor inlet temps, current draw, and UPS load
4) isolate any faulty PDUs and notify datacenter contact

squad-bot: Reminder: "power-test-1771" scheduled Thu 09:00 PT — please react with :white_check_mark: when you have on-site owner assigned.

taylor: on-site owner = jess_fieldops. i added :white_check_mark:. 

jess: confirming field-ops will be on-site Thu. will carry spare power cables and PDUs.

maya: node image notes: image v2.3 includes kernel 6.1. drivers: nvidia 535, CUDA 12.2, NCCL 2.18. test matrix done against H100 and A800. I pushed the canary manifest to repo: `infra/canary/dedicated-v2.yaml`.

jess: grabbing the manifest now. quick diff snippet for the autoscaler settings we changed: 
```
- minReplicas: 2
- maxReplicas: 40
+ minReplicas: 2
+ maxReplicas: 32  # limited for first tranche
```

maya: reason for lowering max: limit first tranche to avoid noisy neighbors on network fabric — we'll scale after monitoring 48h.

dan_procurement: heads up: vendor offered partial early release (10 GPUs) that could let us start canary earlier if customs will clear some units first. is partial racking useful?

taylor: yes, partial early racking would be useful: canary and perf baseline can run with 10 GPUs. need confirmation on rack/power layout.

marco_sre: partial racking ok but power profile changes. i'll update load plan. need exact SKU list for those 10 — dan?

dan_procurement: sending SKU list in a sec. also negotiating customs paperwork to try for priority release.

maya: next actions: 
- dan_procurement: confirm manifest + partial-release plan by EOD today (1771023959)
- marco_sre: update runbook with partial-rack load and share monitoring thresholds by EOD today
- jess: prep node image smoke tests and field-ops packing list by Wed 17:00 PT
- taylor: finalize canary traffic plan + rollback criteria (put into infra/canary/README.md)

jess: ack — i'll post smoke test checklist in this thread when ready.

marco_sre: ack, will post updated runbook & thresholds.

taylor: ack, will push canary README and add an infra alert for latency regression > 15%.

maya: thanks — if anyone sees blockers call them out now. otherwise i'll iterate plan for the standup tomorrow. :thumbsup:

jess: one potential blocker — datacenter needs a certificate for the rack PDUs (their access control). field-ops can get it but need the contact. dan?

dan_procurement: i have the DC contact — will email them and cc field-ops now.

squad-bot: Note: Attachments uploaded: `canary-manifest-diff.patch`, `power-test-runbook-v1.pdf`.

maya: perfect. will update the project board with adjusted ETA if customs doesn't clear by 11/13. otherwise proceed with partial racking plan.

jess: :white_check_mark:

dan_procurement: :pray:

maya: thanks everyone — i'll close this thread after i update the board.
